jobDescription.name: Über uns
jobDescription.value: The appliedAI Initiative elevates Europe’s industry to become shapers in the age of AI, creating a future that we desire to live in. Through our ecosystem of strong partners, comprehensive programs, services and solutions we advance companies holistically on their AI journey. With our uniquely diverse, interdisciplinary, and driven team, we build on deep technical expertise while specializing on applicability of the solutions. We share a mindset of collaboration and openness with our ecosystem of leading companies and tech players. Our common goal is to strengthen the European landscape, jointly creating unique knowledge for applying trustworthy AI. Working alongside experienced strategists and technical experts, you’ll learn how sound AI strategy, use case portfolios, and organizational readiness come together in practice - while getting a technical grounding that goes beyond classic strategy consulting. This is a strong entry point into AI strategy work, with real client exposure from day one.

jobDescription.value:
As the Director (m/f/x) AI Delivery & Teams you own how we deliver our AI consulting and engineering projects for clients, and how the people behind them grow. You lead a team of experienced leaders and the teams behind them, reporting directly to our Managing Director, Andreas Liebl. This is a newly created role and you will lead the area as an equal to our Director AI Solutions & Portfolio.
In our client projects the delivery model is changing fundamentally. People and AI agents work side by side, and that changes what a strong project team looks like and what our people need to be good at. jobDescription.name: Deine Aufgaben
jobDescription.value:
AI engineering at appliedAI runs on real industrial ground: energy, automotive, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing and financial services, with systems that have to hold up in production and not only in a demo. As the practice's most senior technical leader - and the manager who leads and develops the engineers closest to that work - you would set the standards and reference architectures the rest of engineering builds to. If you like being the person others bring the hard architecture question to, and like watching them grow into answering it themselves, this role was built for you.
